description: Native AML compliance for AI agents. Screen any blockchain address (EVM / Tron / Solana) for sanctions, mixers, scam lists, issuer freezes, and on-chain risk before money moves — with verifiable evidence, not a black-box score. Free screening tools need no key; optional x402 pay-per-call tools add full gateway verdicts, deep taint tracing, and batch screening.

environmentVariables.name: OCEANALT_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Backend base URL for the OceanAlt API. Override only for self-hosting or staging.

environmentVariables.name: OCEANALT_PAYER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional payer wallet private key (0x…). When set, unlocks the x402 pay-per-call tools (compliance_decision, deep_trace, batch_screen); used only locally to sign one EIP-3009 USDC authorization — never uploaded or logged. Leave unset to run the free tools only. Use a dedicated low-balance wallet.
